say:0:1710506001:1.text: You stand at the entrance and look around. The grounds are square, hemmed in by rusted iron fencing.
say:0:1710506001:1.source_cn: 你站在墓园入口，环顾四周。墓园呈方形，被生锈的铁栅栏围起。
say:0:1710506001:1.male: You stand at the entrance and look around. The grounds are square, hemmed in by rusted iron fencing.
say:0:1710506001:1.female: You stand at the entrance and look around. The grounds are square, hemmed in by rusted iron fencing.

say:1:1710506002:1.text: Crows perch on the dead trees nearby, their eyes tracking your every move. A chill stirs in your chest.
say:1:1710506002:1.source_cn: 四周的枯树上有一些乌鸦，它们的眼睛盯着你的一举一动，让...
say:1:1710506002:1.male: Crows perch on the dead trees nearby, their eyes tracking your every move. A chill stirs in your chest.
say:1:1710506002:1.female: Crows perch on the dead trees nearby, their eyes tracking your every move. A chill stirs in your chest.

say:2:1710506003:0.text: You take a deep breath and head deeper inside, beginning your search...
say:2:1710506003:0.source_cn: 你深吸一口气，朝着墓园深处走去，开始探索这里……
